must_notice: Both paths have continuous defensible proof
Founder goal distinguishes customer learning from technical depth
Travel upper bound is a real user constraint; example schedules are not guarantees
must_not_assume: ML Engineer is Quant or a product-manager role
Solutions necessarily teaches selling or grants product decision rights
Unknown travel ceiling automatically makes it a confirmed failed constraint
non_blocking_unknowns: Written travel cap can reverse priority
acceptable_recommendations: Conditionally prioritize forward-deployed/solutions given founder goal and travel cap; ML remains genuine backup
Prioritize ML if travel risk is unacceptable or technical founder path is better argued using supplied goals; give an explicit hierarchy
unacceptable_recommendations: Treat both as equally suitable with no hierarchy
Invent a taxonomy label/skill receipt or numeric role-fit score
action_requirements: One primary positioning and a bounded adjacent backup
Confirm travel ceiling and compare real work examples without creating unrelated new projects
reconsideration_requirements: Unacceptable travel or lack of customer/product responsibility can reverse
User goal change toward research depth can favor ML
evidence_requirements: Keep role names as supplied without claiming unsupported taxonomy equivalence
Separate actual code, team platform work and absent sales ownership
expected_commitment: Strongest justified reversible or conditional recommendation; alternate supported choices allowed
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
